latestVersion.changelog:
Job Search Tracker 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a comprehensive job search tracker: track applications from initial submission to offer, all in a single markdown file (`applications.md`).
- Integrates with Gmail and LinkedIn (when available) to auto-detect applications, retrieve updates, and pull context.
- Flags stale applications, upcoming interviews, and overdue follow-ups with proactive reminders and dashboard summaries.
- Assists with drafting cover letters, follow-up emails, thank-you notes, and interview prep materials based on application data.
- Provides analytics and an at-a-glance dashboard to monitor job search progress.
